en.title: FEES Schedule 6, table 6.2 (crowdfunding platforms): no rule for funds raised of exactly 1 million USD
en.summary: The variable fee is "not applicable" where "the funds raised is less than 1 million USD", and a levy applies to the whole amount where "the funds raised is more than 1 million USD". Funds raised of exactly 1 million USD in a quarter are covered by no branch, while the outcomes on either side differ. The draft in Consultation Paper AFSA-PSRD-CSP-2026-0004 raises the threshold to 5.3, 5.5 and 5.8 million USD for 2027, 2028 and 2029 with the same wording ("less than" and "more than"), so the gap moves to those amounts.
en.correction: Please allocate funds raised of exactly the threshold amount in a quarter to one band only, both in the current text (USD 1 million) and in the draft (USD 5.3, 5.5 and 5.8 million).
